title: Milanese embassy at Buda, 1489-90: Maffeo da Treviglio's cipher (ASMi Sforzesco 642/650)

plaintext.source: Somogyi 2016 (Verbum 17) printed the decipherment of lines 1-2 only

transcription.source: Vestigia 3240x4320 images, segmented into strips and crops
transcription.notes: Only p. 1 ll. 1-10 (564 signs) were transcribed to tokens; the rest was read by eye from crops, so no full sign count exists. Lines 1-2 reproduce Somogyi exactly. Page 4 has two cipher lines, then a clear postscript.

plaintext.source: No decipherment; the clear page 2 restates part of the cipher block

transcription.notes: Count from NOTES (agent's 469 signs); the CSV mixes clear and cipher rows, so not measured. Agent pass conflated z/3, d/ð, s/ſ, u/v; second pass by eye on raw crops.
Calibration letter: aligned with its clear extract to pin glyphs to Somogyi's numbers.

system.summary: Italian monoalphabetic-homophonic cipher of letter-like signs, figures and marks, with vowel homophones, nulls, geminate and syllable signs and a small nomenclator.

diacritics.note: Superscript a/e/o/u/t/s, macron, stroke and dot turn a base sign into a syllable or another letter (q^e = re, m^a = sa, m-macron = b).

system.notes: Per Somogyi 2016: 21 letters, 5 nulls, et/in/che signs, 5 geminates, 32 syllable signs, 6 nomenclator entries. Her key is numeric only; glyphs were pinned here via Vestigia 267/268. Unidentified signs remain (q^s+x-bar, a capital-E sign, a wavy null).

prior_solution.where: Somogyi 2016: key in numeric form and lines 1-2 of the 22 Nov 1489 letter

conditions.human_role: Fetched the DECODE images behind login.

solution.what: Somogyi 2016 key and cipher/clear pairs; Vestigia API and DECODE records located; clear copies found for R1155 and R1147.
Segmentation and agent transcription of R1098, 267 and 2831 p. 1 strips; several agents lost to the rate limit.
Somogyi's numbers follow first occurrence in 267, so aligning 267 with its clear extract 268 pins glyphs to values; 267 decodes almost verbatim.
R1098 read in gist, all ten cipher lines.
R1098 ll. 7-10 restate the letter's clear page 2.
2831 ll. 1-2 reproduce Somogyi's printed decipherment exactly.
22 Nov 1489 letter read across all four pages, new sign values gained along the way.
Framing corrected: 'nobody had deciphered' becomes 'no published decipherment'; Somogyi held the key and printed a specimen of the letter.

Reclassified from 'read' to 'read in part': no measured share of signs read; page 3 of the 1489 letter after l. 19 read only in patches (about a third of its words), four signs unvalued, R1098 ll. 5, 6, 9 short groups open. NOTES gain Remaining gaps and Escalation sections; next step is a full token transcription and a measured count.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): V2831 per-page sign transcriptions (trans/v2831p*) and v2831_reading.md; R1098 trans/r1098p1_v.txt/.csv and r1098_reading.md; V267 trans/v267.csv with the clear extract (plaintexts.md, plain267.txt); key.md and key.json. 2831 has sign-by-line notes, not one token file, as Remaining gaps says.

Reading audit (George Lasry's sentence test): v2831_reading.md and r1098_reading.md read through. V2831 p. 1 and p. 2 ll. 1-16 build sentences with scattered holes; p. 2 ll. 17-32 and p. 3 are lines of fragments with [...] in most lines. The V2831 entry split: the second part relabelled decoded, not read; R1098 kept read (reviewed B). fraction_read set to ~0.56 of cipher lines (estimated); class stays read in part.

Re-read brief b25: DECODE key records of Milan 1480s-90s checked: R1099/R1169 = the 1488 Arcimboldo-Oliva key (different: che = ds, a+ = Protonotario). Headings of all 134 ASMi Sforzesco cart. 1597 key records read on contact sheets (research/reading_audit/b25_keysheets.py): no. 111 (DECODE R5411) is headed 'Cum Mapheo Triviliensi', the original key of this cipher (alphabet torn at T-&, doubles, nulls, syllable table, 22-entry nomenclator), transcribed in key_R5411.md; it confirms Somogyi's values where both exist. No. 107 (R5407) 'Cum Mafeo Triviliensi' is a different alphabet.

V2831 p. 2 ll. 17-30 and p. 3 (31 lines) re-transcribed sign by sign from the Vestigia plates with per-row crops (two helper agents, one per page; trans/v2831p2_b25.md, v2831p3_b25.md, corrections tsv). Line counts corrected: p. 2 has 30 lines, p. 3 31.

Both pages re-decoded with R5411: x-bar = Ma (q^s x-bar = Roma, 4 times), M+ = Regina, a# = Vostra Dominatio, Q. = Duca de Milano, Ra = madonna Bianca, + = Vescovo Varadino, fa, bi, pp, rr adopted (each holds at every occurrence). Flagged: the o-form (b by the key, t in most words), delta+ = Papa (sense), g = x in excusar (torn column). Look-alike letters: p. 2 15 (+9 o-form), p. 3 59 of ~1,360.

Partial reading v2831_p2p3_reading.md (English v2831_p2p3_en.md, log v2831_p2p3_reread_log.md). b17_score.py LANG_=it on the body: 0.322 (19/59), explicit holes 0.542; before 0.158 / 0.342. p. 2 ll. 17-27 and half of p. 3 build sentences; the rest fragments. Stays decoded, not read.

outcome.method_basis: Somogyi 2016 published the key of Maffeo da Treviglio's cipher in numeric form; it was tied to the glyphs here by aligning Vestigia 267 with its clear extract 268 and then applied to the 22 Nov 1489 letter and DECODE R1098, gaining some new sign values.
outcome.notes: Read in part since 22 Sept 2026: share of signs read not measured, p. 3 of the 1489 letter after l. 19 in patches. Readings are in gist in places; a few signs unidentified and stained line ends. 'matched control' refers to Somogyi's printed lines 1-2. 22 Oct 2026, reading audit: V2831 split into a read part (p. 1, p. 2 ll. 1-16, p. 4) and a decoded-not-read part (p. 2 ll. 17-32, p. 3); R1098 reviewed B.

texts.label: Vestigia 2831, Buda 22 Nov 1489: p. 1, p. 2 ll. 1-16 and the two cipher lines of p. 4
texts.summary: Maffeo da Treviglio to Ludovico Sforza: King Matthias Corvinus wants peace but not on terms to his dishonour, and will not go to the Diet unless he can come away justified; the new Neapolitan ambassador is to negotiate a reconciliation with the Emperor, and talk of a marriage for the King's son John Corvinus is raised again. Page 3 is read only in patches after line 19.

reading_review.note: Page 1 and page 2 lines 1-16 build Italian sentences with scattered [...] holes (Matthias wants peace but not at the cost of his honour; the Neapolitan ambassador; the Milan match), with an English sense per section; page 4's two cipher lines read. Only this part counts as read.

texts.label: Vestigia 2831, Buda 22 Nov 1489: p. 2 ll. 17-30 and p. 3 (p. 2 has 30 lines, p. 3 31)
texts.note: Re-read 23 Oct 2026 (b25; v2831_p2p3_reread_log.md): the original key 'Cum Mapheo Triviliensi' (ASMi Sforzesco cart. 1597 no. 111, DECODE R5411) found and both pages re-read sign by sign from the plates with per-row crops (trans/v2831p2_b25.md, v2831p3_b25.md): Roma (q^s x-bar), la Regina, Vostra Dominatio, the Duke of Milan, the Pope, madonna Bianca, the bishop of Varad now read. p. 2 ll. 17-27 and about half of p. 3 build sentences, but p. 2 ll. 28-30 and eleven lines of p. 3 stay fragments: body 0.322 clean sentences (it; before 0.158), explicit holes 0.542. Still decoded, not read; the remaining groups are legible but not yet segmented (not-attempted after two passes), one blot (illegible), torn key columns (no-key-material).

texts.label: DECODE R1098, Buda 12 Jan 1490
texts.summary: Maffeo to Ludovico Sforza: the King left on the 8th for Vienna, less drawn by hope of the Diet than by his own wish to go; the legate, the other ambassadors and Maffeo have decided to leave on the 15th. Ten cipher lines after a clear passage; short groups in ll. 5, 6 and 9 unread.

reading_review.note: Ten cipher lines: ll. 1-4 and 7-8 read whole ('Questo Ser.mo Re partite de qua ali 8 del presente per andare ad Vienna ...'), ll. 5-6 and 9-10 with holes; confirmed by the clear p. 2 of the same letter; English sense given.

texts.label: Vestigia 267, Vienna 2 Apr 1490 (calibration letter)
texts.summary: Calibration pair: the cipher letter of 2 Apr 1490 with its contemporary clear extract (Vestigia 268): the Turkish ambassador is still at court and treats, among other things, of a prolongation of the peace.

reading_review.note: Calibration letter: its contemporary clear copy (plain267.txt) is continuous Italian.

outcome.fraction_read_source: 22 Oct 2026, reading audit: only text that builds sentences counts. Counted in cipher lines (signs per line not measured for V2831): V2831 has 91 cipher lines (p. 1 29, p. 2 32, p. 3 28, p. 4 2), of which p. 1, p. 2 ll. 1-16 and p. 4 (47 lines) read; R1098's 10 lines read. 57 of 101 lines, about 0.56, estimated. V267 (calibration letter with its clear copy) not counted.
